newsitem.title: MEXICO: Desc Q2 net per share seen down.
newsitem.headline: Desc Q2 net per share seen down.

text.p: Analysts forecast conglomerate Desc will post firm sales but lower net earnings for the first half of the year.

A Reuters survey of three analysts showed they predicted average sales of 6.461 billion pesos for the year to the end of June, up 4.7 percent in real terms from the same period last year, bolstered by a strong autoparts division.
Net earnings, however, were seen down 30.3 percent in real terms to 938 million pesos, or 3.10 pesos per share. The analysts said higher financial costs would undermine earnings.
Roberto Solano, an analyst with the Ixe brokerage said Desc could expect a mixed performance from its diverse subsidiaries.
"The autoparts and agribusiness divisions have offset the decline in chemicals, consumer products and real estate," a recent research report from Ixe said.
